scope: Offline measurements taken on a macOS dev machine with no gamepad, no participants and no hardware. NOT the docs/SPEC.md section 12 study. H1 latency, H2 false triggers and H3 throughput remain unmeasured.
machine: macOS, Python 3.11.15, 640x480 webcam, output=null (no gamepad on this platform)

loto_accuracy.what: helm.gestures.GestureModel.fit(): holds out each complete take, refits selection and scaling inside each fold, classifies the held-out take by its median scores
loto_accuracy.caveat: Three committed dev profiles, not three participants. Enrollment validation only: it is not event recall and not a new-session false-activation rate.

false_triggers_offline.what: Leave-one-negative-take-out: hold out one recorded everyday-face take, refit on the rest, replay the held-out take through the real GestureEngine and Mapper via eval/learned_replay.evaluate. The held-out take is never in the training data.
false_triggers_offline.finding: All three fires came from the permissive default mapping, which puts every learned gesture on A. Under both real game mappings there were zero fires.
caveats: 57.5 s of everyday face against the protocol's 540 s (3 participants x 180 s).
Timestamps synthesised at 30 fps; the recordings carry no timestamps.
Takes are 0.5-14.8 s, so one fire in a 1.3 s take reports as 47/min. The pooled rate is the honest figure.
Enrollment negatives, not a fresh session of reading, chatting and watching.

control_path_only_mock_ms.note: mock bypasses MediaPipe: normalize -> gestures -> mapper -> pad only

full_pipeline_real_camera_ms.note: total_ms = t_output - t_capture. Software latency only, NOT motion-to-screen (H1).

voided.reason: taken on camera index 0, which delivers black frames; MediaPipe does far less work with no face. Wrong by more than 2x.

software_latency.not_in_software_latency_csv: One person on a dev machine is not a study row; pooling it with demo-laptop participants would mix machines inside one median.

reproduce: Scripts live in the session scratchpad, not the repo: loto.py and false_offline.py. They import helm.gestures and eval/learned_replay unchanged. eval/ is P3-owned, so they were not added there.
